name: autotask-mcp
description: Every Autotask entity at the command line, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers ticket-aging, workload, unbilled-time, and account-360 questions no other Autotask tool can.

autotask_api_integration_code.title: AUTOTASK_API_INTEGRATION_CODE
autotask_api_integration_code.description: Sets AUTOTASK_API_INTEGRATION_CODE for the Autotask PSA MCP server.

autotask_psa_secret.title: AUTOTASK_PSA_SECRET
autotask_psa_secret.description: Sets AUTOTASK_PSA_SECRET for the Autotask PSA MCP server.

autotask_psa_user_name.title: AUTOTASK_PSA_USER_NAME
autotask_psa_user_name.description: Sets AUTOTASK_PSA_USER_NAME for the Autotask PSA MCP server.

autotask_base_url.title: Autotask PSA API base URL
autotask_base_url.description: Base URL for the Autotask PSA API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

autotask_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
autotask_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any tool that changes Autotask. Leave blank to keep every tool (each write still previews and acts only with confirm: true).

autotask_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
autotask_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

autotask_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
autotask_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

autotask_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
autotask_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Autotask requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
